repository.name: FitzpatrickFamilyPlatform
repository.checkout_resolution: Resolve the authoritative checkout locally; no absolute path is part of this publishable subject.
repository.baseline_requirement: Implementation may initialize only from this exact clean baseline or from a later clean baseline explicitly reaccepted by the Architecture Gatekeeper.

initiative.objective: Implement a passive, repository-only, deterministic consumer that interprets governed PLAT-14.1A synthetic Operational Health Assessment fixtures without recalculating or replacing their authoritative health conclusions.

current_authority_boundary.board_disposition: Preparation of this exact Architecture Review subject only.
current_authority_boundary.next_gate: Architecture Gatekeeper acceptance or required changes for this exact subject.

required_reuse.prohibition: The implementation must not duplicate, fork, weaken, or change the PLAT-14.1A assessment model, parser, serializer, validation, health policy, confidence policy, precedence, reason-code catalog, or freshness calculation.

proposed_changed_path_allowlist.integration_rule: Charlie may state the required CLI hook and traceability changes but may not concurrently edit an Architecture Integration-owned path. Each such path requires an explicit integration lease or a serialized Architecture Integration change after all overlapping Alpha changes are reconciled.

field_rules.request_id: Nonempty stable identifier containing only lower-case ASCII letters, digits, and hyphens.
field_rules.presented_at: Timezone-aware RFC3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z.
field_rules.assessment: Either null or an inline JSON object parsed only by assessment_from_dict and checked by validate_assessment.

input_contract.unsafe_envelope_behavior: Reject before interpretation with exit code 2 and produce no interpretation result.

pass_through_contract.valid_source_rule: For a valid assessment, source_assessment must equal assessment_to_dict(parsed_assessment) field-for-field and value-for-value. No source field may be omitted, renamed, rewritten, summarized, rescored, or recomputed.
pass_through_contract.invalid_source_rule: For a parse-invalid or validation-invalid assessment, source_assessment is null, source status is not interpreted, and only bounded validation findings are emitted. The unvalidated payload is not copied to the output.

precedence: If assessment parsing or published validation fails, invalid.
If valid_until is present and presented_at is later than valid_until, noncurrent and include ASSESSMENT_EXPIRED.
Otherwise, current. Equality with valid_until is current. A valid not_evaluated assessment with no valid_until is current as a source record but is not converted into health.
consumer_state_contract.boundary: Consumer state is presentation metadata only. It never changes source health_status, assessment_confidence, freshness, validity, reasons, findings, or evidence.

precedence: invalid: review_evidence using consumer validation findings only; no source health recommendation.
unavailable: obtain_governed_assessment; do not synthesize not_evaluated.
noncurrent: reevaluate; do not present or recommend from the stored health as current.
current unhealthy or any critical finding: investigate.
current insufficient_evidence with other reason codes: review_evidence.
current healthy with ADVISORY_TELEMETRY_PARTIAL or RESOURCE_EVIDENCE_STALE: review_evidence while explicitly preserving healthy source status.
recommendation_contract.basis_rule: Every source-derived recommendation must cite the exact source reason codes and all source evidence_ids supporting the source assessment. Consumer-only invalid, unavailable, or expired recommendations use an empty source basis and cite the applicable consumer finding in the summary.

field_rules.interpretation_id: Deterministic operations-intelligence- prefix plus the first 20 lower-case hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over canonical sorted-key UTF-8 request JSON.
field_rules.source_assessment: Full canonical published assessment dictionary or null under the pass-through contract.
field_rules.source_validation_findings: Stable severity, code, and message records sorted by severity, code, and message.
field_rules.consumer_findings: Stable severity, code, and message records sorted by severity, code, and message.
field_rules.recommendations: Stable list ordered by the recommendation precedence and then category; recommendation_id is recommendation-01, recommendation-02, and so on.

commands.behavior: Read one request only from engineering/tests/fixtures/operations_intelligence, validate it strictly, and emit deterministic interpretation JSON to stdout without writing a file.
Read one interpretation only from engineering/tests/fixtures/operations_intelligence, validate the output contract, and emit PASS or bounded findings without writing a file.
Read one valid interpretation only from engineering/tests/fixtures/operations_intelligence and emit deterministic sanitized Markdown to stdout without writing a file.

cli_contract.path_boundary: Reject absolute paths, symlinks, path traversal, non-files, and paths outside engineering/tests/fixtures/operations_intelligence.

exit_codes.0: Valid command and valid domain result, including current, noncurrent, unavailable, or invalid consumer state.
exit_codes.2: Malformed JSON, unsafe path, unsafe request envelope, invalid arguments, I/O failure, or invalid interpretation document.
exit_codes.3: Unsupported request, assessment, or interpretation contract version.

cli_contract.shared_path_rule: Charlie specifies this hook, but engineering/platform_eap/cli.py is Architecture Integration-owned and must be changed only in a serialized integration phase.

fixture_contract.source_fixture_rule: The current-healthy case must embed the exact logical object from engineering/tests/fixtures/container_health/assessments/healthy.json at SHA-256 6bb08659677ef8a32f7f692025878911d67c0bdad96d161b5179252675cabe20. Other assessment cases are sanitized deterministic mutations that must pass the unchanged published parser and validator unless the case explicitly tests invalid input.
fixture_contract.safety_rule: No fixture may name a production subject, customer, credential, protected path, reachable endpoint, or live provider target.

required_proofs: All fourteen cases produce the exact expected state, recommendations, findings, and deterministic ordering.
Every valid source assessment round-trips through assessment_to_dict unchanged in source_assessment.
Source health_status, assessment_confidence, freshness, valid_until, reasons, findings, reconciliation, policy versions, and evidence references are never rewritten.
Expired stored healthy is noncurrent and never rendered as current Healthy.
Parse-invalid and validation-invalid assessments expose no interpreted source status.
Provider limitation never becomes subject health.
Advisory partial telemetry creates no health escalation.
Unknown input and output keys, unsafe paths, symlinks, traversal, unsupported versions, activation, access, model execution, and live-work claims fail closed.
CLI JSON and Markdown output are byte-for-byte deterministic and stdout-only.
The three new capability modules import no socket, subprocess, requests, urllib, http, docker, prometheus_client, model, or plugin surface and call no file-writing or mutation API.
No PLAT-14.1A source module, fixture, policy, Registry record, provider adapter, proxy, deployment, dashboard, or FFFA path changes.

acceptance_gates: Architecture Gatekeeper accepts the exact subject digest, candidate initiative identity, baseline or explicitly reaccepted successor baseline, authoritative evidence hashes, ownership split, allowlist, contracts, non-goals, and stop conditions.
A separately initialized Charlie session proves a clean, non-diverged, authority-consistent baseline before any implementation.
Architecture Integration confirms no concurrent Alpha ownership of shared paths and grants an explicit serialized integration lease before any shared path changes.
./platform-eap repository validate and ./platform-eap governance validate pass.
AI Session Readiness is run only under the published generated-evidence baseline policy; any unclassified generated change stops the session.
Literal changed paths equal a subset of the exact allowlist, with shared paths changed only under the integration lease; git diff --check passes.
A requirement audit proves exact source pass-through, deterministic schemas, no source recalculation, no live/provider/model/command activity, and no false precision.
Architecture Gatekeeper performs implementation review before publication; commit and push require a separate publication authorization and remote-equality proof.
deferred_mappings: Final production-provider provenance, provider-failure, limitation, coverage, and named-target mappings pending separately accepted Bravo evidence.
Comparison or trend interpretation across multiple compatible assessments.
PLAT-14.3A dashboard consumer mappings and no-data presentation.
Any authoritative service, live provider, runtime, alert, notification, remediation, runbook, or operational activation mapping.
non_goals: Recalculate, replace, amend, or independently summarize authoritative health, confidence, reconciliation, freshness, validity, reason codes, findings, or evidence.
Create another health assessment, consumer-summary source of truth, policy engine, score, trend system, threshold, urgency, probability, prediction, or root-cause engine.
Modify PLAT-14.1A source logic, schemas, policies, fixtures, Registry data, provider adapters, proxy code, deployment configuration, dashboard, or APIs.
Access providers, network, runtime, production, protected locations, customer data, credentials, dashboards, APIs, or live infrastructure.
Execute commands, remediation, runbooks, alerts, notifications, scheduling, dispatch, persistence, background work, or model inference from the capability.
Activate the Operations Analyst, Execution Agent, automation, consumer, provider, or any runtime behavior.
Implement EO-14.3A, PLAT-14.3A, final provider mappings, or unrelated Milestone 15 work.
Commit, push, release, deploy, publish, or promote lifecycle state under this proposal.
stop_conditions: Repository identity, branch, clean state, tracking equality, authority, baseline, or any binding evidence hash is absent, ambiguous, drifted, dirty, behind, diverged, or materially different.
Charlie authority remains absent or contradictory, or the Architecture Gatekeeper has not accepted this exact subject.
A changed path is outside the exact allowlist, or Charlie attempts a shared path without an Architecture Integration lease.
Alpha concurrently owns or has unreconciled changes to a shared path.
Implementation requires modifying container_health.py, container_health_io.py, PLAT policy, reason-code, assessment, Registry, provider, proxy, deployment, dashboard, or FFFA artifacts.
The published parser or validator cannot support a case without duplication, weakening, special-casing, or source recalculation.
A recommendation requires evidence not present in the authoritative assessment or requires invented telemetry, precision, trend, urgency, probability, prediction, root cause, or remediation.
A final provider, named-target, dashboard, metrics, live, or operational mapping is needed.
Network, subprocess, command execution, file writing, persistence, credentials, customer data, protected access, runtime, provider access, production, activation, or live work is required.
A validator changes an unapproved path or generated evidence cannot be classified under published policy.
Focused or governed validation fails, or deterministic fixture output differs from the accepted contract.

completion_state.before_acceptance: Charlie remains unstarted; Architecture Review only.
completion_state.after_subject_acceptance: Acceptance may authorize only a separately bounded publication step that places these exact subject bytes at repository_publication_target and performs accepted integration-owned traceability changes. Charlie implementation remains unstarted until that publication is committed, pushed, and remote equality is proved.
completion_state.after_subject_publication: The published subject becomes repository authority for a separately initialized implementation session only if the Gatekeeper decision explicitly grants that delayed effect and all baseline and integration gates pass.
completion_state.after_implementation: Implementation remains unpublished and unactivated pending separate Architecture Gatekeeper implementation review and publication authorization.
completion_state.provider_and_live_state: Deferred and unauthorized in every state of this subject.
